SinchIndiaRedirectUri.Description: Exact ChatGPT callback for the separate sinch plugin; empty keeps its OAuth disabled.

ProviderConfigRevision.Description: Builder checksum of separate-provider callback configuration; forces immutable Lambda version replacement.
